title: 第一卷 第13章 我想要银子第一卷 第14章 上我的车
lines: 钟显升整个人此时额头上也满是冷汗！
两个人在同一个厨房，而陈玄的做饭方式，他闻所未闻。
每一个菜式的新颖程度，他同样是想象不到。
但是即便如此，他也完全想象不到，自己的前六道菜，居然全部都是败了。
看着陈玄伸出来的手，他的嘴角抽搐了一下，而后他咬了咬牙，从怀里抹除了一张五十两的银票，他深吸了一口气道：“小兄弟，你这厨艺，是跟谁学的。”
“我自己研究的！”陈玄接过了银票，他脸上露出笑容道：“最近正好穷了，这五十两，我就笑纳了！”
“不是，小兄弟，你这菜谱，有没有兴趣卖，价格你可以随便开！”钟显升道。
陈玄神色一动。
卖菜谱？
陈玄确实是有这个想法，但是不是现在。
炒菜这个事情并不是什么难事儿，只要多看多吃，总是能够猜测到的。
只是在调味上，稍微有些麻烦而已，但是作为这个世界的大厨，钟显升的煮菜水平其实已经很高了，调味对于他来说，不算太过困难！
但是陈玄如今依然没打算去贩卖。
他打算在和白浅浅相处熟悉了之后，他和白浅浅合作，开一个酒楼！
他练武急需银子，而且现在看起来，这是一个无底洞，只是刚刚进入修炼，功法，丹药什么的，可能都需要上百两，才能够短时间内，堆出一个一品的武者。
陈玄走这条路子，更难，他估摸着到了后面，肯定要依靠药材和丹药才行。
当然，陈玄也没把话给说死，他笑眯眯的打量着钟显升说道：“不知道你打算开什么价格？”
“一千两！”钟显升对着陈玄伸出了一根手指！
“一千两？”陈玄疑惑的问道：“一道菜的菜谱？”
钟显升咬牙说道：“自然不是…你所有的！”
“你想多了！”陈玄撇嘴！
“小子，你这菜谱可能颠覆这个世界的美食格局，你想要捏在手上，你是捏不住的。”钟显升道。
“你在威胁我？”陈玄嘴角含笑道。
钟显升道：“那你开个价吧！”
“我说了啊，一千两一个菜的菜谱！”陈玄道。
“哼！”钟显升冷笑了一声。
陈玄也不再理会他，两人继续准备着后面的菜。
而陈玄也依然不负所望，十道菜下来，他全部都赢了！
甚至包括了最后的一道菜，只是一碗简单的蛋炒饭，但是这些贵妇人们，几乎都是吃得一粒米饭都没有剩下！
大厅之中，柳夫人舔了舔自己的嘴唇，她那绝美的脸上，有着一种意犹未尽的味道。
此时有人不断的和白浅浅聊着天。
显然，这美食让他们心动，而白浅浅，每日都可以吃到，他们想要下次再吃的话，就必须得和白浅浅打好关系！
这个时候，柳夫人道：“来人，把将军府的大厨请进来！今日吃了此等美食，我定要好好的奖赏他！”
后厨！

;;
Zhong Xiansheng's forehead was covered in cold sweat at this time!
The two of them were in the same kitchen, and Chen Xuan's cooking method was something he had never heard of before.
He also couldn't imagine the novelty of each dish.
But even so, he never imagined that all of his first six dishes would fail.
Looking at Chen Xuan's outstretched hand, the corner of his mouth twitched, then he gritted his teeth and wiped a fifty-tael banknote from his arms. He took a deep breath and said, "Little brother, who did you learn this cooking skill from?"
"I researched it myself!" Chen Xuan took the banknote and said with a smile on his face: "I happened to be poor recently, so I accepted these fifty taels with a smile!"
Zhong Xiansheng: "..."
"No, little brother, if you are interested in selling this recipe, you can set the price as you like!" Zhong Xiansheng said.
Chen Xuan's expression changed.
Selling recipes?
Chen Xuan does have this idea, but not now.
Cooking is not a difficult thing. As long as you watch more and eat more, you can always guess it.
It's just that the seasoning is a little troublesome, but as a master chef in this world, Zhong Xiansheng's cooking level is actually very high, and seasoning is not too difficult for him!
But Chen Xuan still has no intention of selling it.
He planned to cooperate with Bai Qianqian to open a restaurant after they got to know each other well!
He is in urgent need of money for martial arts training, and now it seems that this is a bottomless pit. But he has just started practicing, and he may need hundreds of taels of skills, elixirs, etc., to be able to build a first-class warrior in a short time.
It would be more difficult for Chen Xuan to take this path. He estimated that he would have to rely on medicinal materials and elixirs later.
Of course, Chen Xuan didn't say anything. He looked at Zhong Xiansheng with a smile and said, "I wonder what price you plan to offer?"
"One thousand taels!" Zhong Xiansheng stretched out a finger towards Chen Xuan!
"A thousand taels?" Chen Xuan asked doubtfully, "A recipe for a dish?"
Zhong Xiansheng gritted his teeth and said, "Of course it's not...all yours!"
"You're thinking too much!" Chen Xuan pouted!
"Boy, this recipe of yours may overturn the food pattern of this world. If you want to hold it in your hands, you won't be able to hold it," Zhong Xiansheng said.
"Are you threatening me?" Chen Xuan said with a smile on his face.
Zhong Xiansheng said: "Then make a price!"
"I told you, a recipe for one thousand taels per dish!" Chen Xuandao.
"Humph!" Zhong Xiansheng sneered.
Chen Xuan ignored him and the two continued to prepare the next dish.
And Chen Xuan still lived up to his expectations. After ten dishes, he won all of them!
It even included the last dish, which was just a bowl of simple egg fried rice, but these ladies almost ate without even a grain of rice left!
In the hall, Mrs. Liu licked her lips, and there was a lingering taste on her beautiful face.
At this time, someone kept chatting with Bai Qianqian.
Obviously, this delicacy makes their hearts flutter, and Bai Qianqian can eat it every day. If they want to eat it again next time, they must have a good relationship with Bai Qianqian!
At this time, Mrs. Liu said: "Come here, invite the chef of the General's Mansion! After eating such delicious food today, I will reward him well!"
Kitchen!
